Section Underperforming Count.name: Section Underperforming Count
Section Underperforming Count.description:
Wide-format per-band measures for the distribution bar charts (Value-only
binding, no Legend/Category needed) -- each is a thin CALCULATE wrapper
around 'Section Band Count' with the band fixed, so the counting logic
itself is defined once and reused, not duplicated.

Section Row Matches Filter.name: Section Row Matches Filter
Section Row Matches Filter.description:
Connects the (unrelated) _PerformanceBands slicer to the Section detail
table: TRUE for every row when nothing is selected, otherwise TRUE only
for rows whose Selected Performance matches the picked band.

Category Row Matches Filter.name: Category Row Matches Filter
Category Row Matches Filter.description:
Same pattern as 'Section Row Matches Filter', using the separate
_CategoryPerformanceBands table so the Category slicer doesn't cross-sync
with the Section slicer (they'd otherwise share filter state since both
point at the same underlying Band values).

Selected Chart Mode.name: Selected Chart Mode
Selected Chart Mode.description: Which view the KPI card sparklines render: Actual (absolute values vs the real P20-P80 band) or vs Benchmark (deviation from that day's P50). Driven by the chart_mode_selector slicer on the disconnected _ChartMode table; defaults to Actual when nothing is selected.

Selected As Of Date.name: Selected As Of Date
Selected As Of Date.description:
The trading day the dashboard reports on, chosen via the as_of_slicer on the
disconnected _AsOfDate table. Falls back to the latest day that actually has
data, so the dashboard opens on "Current day".

Selected Diff.name: Selected Diff
Selected Diff.description:
Absolute gap to benchmark for the selected metric: actual minus P50, in the
metric's own units (currency for Sales, bills for Bills, points for Margin).
Complements [Selected vs Bench], which gives the same gap as a percentage.
Blank when no benchmark exists, matching the other Selected measures.
